questions.q: According to the Bihar Economic Survey 2024-25, the growth rate of Bihar's economy in 2023-24 was:
questions.explanation: According to the Bihar Economic Survey 2024-25, the growth rate of Bihar's economy in 2023-24 was 9.2%.

questions.q: Which sector contributes the largest share in the Gross Value Added (GVA) of Bihar?
questions.explanation: The tertiary (services) sector contributes the largest share (~58.6%) in Bihar's GVA.

questions.q: Which district of Bihar has the highest per capita GSDP?
questions.explanation: Patna has the highest per capita GSDP (Rs 1,21,396/person), followed by Begusarai and Munger. Sheohar has the lowest.

questions.q: Which is the most cultivated crop of Bihar (2023-24)?
questions.explanation: In 2023-24 rice (9522.9 thousand tonnes) was the most cultivated crop, followed by wheat and maize.

questions.q: Which district is the largest producer of rice and wheat in Bihar?
questions.explanation: Rohtas leads in rice and wheat production in Bihar. Purnia leads in maize and Patna in pulses.

questions.q: In which districts is the maximum production of litchi and banana respectively found in Bihar?
questions.explanation: Muzaffarpur leads in litchi production and Bhagalpur in banana production. Rohtas leads in guava and Darbhanga in mango.

questions.q: Which district of Bihar has the largest reserve of pyrite, containing 95% of India's reserves?
questions.explanation: Rohtas (Amjhaur and Banjari) has pyrite reserves forming about 95% of India's total; pyrite is the main source of sulphur.

questions.q: Which mineral, of which the highest-quality in the world is found in Bihar, is a bad conductor of electricity?
questions.explanation: The highest-quality mica in the world is found in Bihar (Nawada, Gaya, Jamui, Munger). Being a bad conductor of electricity it is used in electrical equipment.

questions.q: Gold deposits have been discovered mainly in which district of Bihar?
questions.explanation: Huge gold reserves have been discovered at Karmitia in Jamui district (gold is also found in Munger and West Champaran).

questions.q: Which is the first (oldest) sugar industry of Bihar, established in 1904?
questions.explanation: The first sugar industry of Bihar was established in 1904 at Marhaura/Madhaura in Saran.

questions.q: Which is the first oil refinery of Bihar?
questions.explanation: The Barauni Refinery (Begusarai) is the first oil refinery of Bihar.

questions.q: Which is the only railway zone headquartered in Bihar?
questions.explanation: East Central Railway, headquartered at Hajipur, is the only railway zone located in Bihar. It was established on 1 October 2002.

questions.q: Which national waterway passes through the Ganga in Bihar?
questions.explanation: National Waterway-1 runs along the Ganga (1620 km through UP, Bihar, Jharkhand and West Bengal).

questions.q: In Bihar, the largest share of irrigation is done through which means?
questions.explanation: Tube wells irrigate the largest area (63.1%) in Bihar, followed by canals (31%).
